title: pedicularis rex subsp. pseudocyathus
intro: Pedicularis rex subsp. pseudocyathus, commonly known as the Royal Foxglove or King Foxglove, is a plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Pedicularis rex subsp. pseudocyathus include iridoid glycosides, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
